Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files with extensions .lockedfile, .lockymap (v1) and .locky (v2)
Utilizes Command & Control servers on the Tor network
Encryption with RSA keys; attackers demand ransom for decryption
Discoverer: Brigade d’enquêtes sur les fraudes aux technologies de l’information (BEFTI)
Service des technologies et des systèmes d’information de la sécurité intérieure (ST(SI)²)
Impacted Systems: Professional environments including SMEs, large businesses, associations
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection leading to file encryption
Command & Control servers on Tor network
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes containing Tor network C2 server addresses
Presence of PyLocky_Decryptor_V1_V2.jar file for decryption
